tells: 1. Face close reads as game CG: polygonal jaw/cheek silhouette, waxy uniform skin with no subsurface, claw-like rigid fingers under the chin and a pearl necklace floating off the skin (club-4-face.png, centre: face, hand and neck)

2. The laugh barely builds in 1 s: until t=12.6 the whole front row is still, then two people raise a hand to chin or head while the rest stay hands-on-table; it reads as triggered gestures rather than a laugh spreading through the room (club-5-strip.png, front row, all frames)

3. Visible cast repetition: two near-identical blondes with a bun and two short-haired blondes, and the same outfits recurring table to table, so the eye spots clones in the mid shots (club-3-mid.png, centre and right rows; club-2-mid.png, left-centre)

4. Back rows are flat dark cut-outs and standing silhouettes with no shading or rim and identical heights, a flat-card wall of people behind the lit tables (club-1-wide.png, upper middle band; club-2-mid.png, top left by the bar)

5. Stray compositing artefacts: a thin dark diagonal line down the right edge, a floating red bokeh dot beside the stool woman, and that woman isolated alone in empty black space (club-6-held.png, right third)

1. The wide is a line-up: two lit rows sitting bolt upright, hands on knees, facing the same way with the same spacing, like a class photo; the held-out frame is nearly identical, so the room looks frozen (theatre-1-wide.png and theatre-6-held.png, centre rows)

2. The audience behind is flat shaded impostors and silhouettes, with people apparently standing in the side aisles (left x~100, right x~1190) and heads stacked like cardboard, which kills the depth of the theatre (theatre-1-wide.png, upper half and both sides)
3. The reaction is late and small: nothing moves until t=12.6, then a few mouths open and one hand goes to the face, with the back rows completely static (theatre-5-strip.png, all frames)

4. Face close: the open mouth looks mechanical with a flat tongue and teeth, rigid claw hand, faceted jaw and ear edges, and a bright halo/rim on the jacket edge against the blurred background (theatre-4-face.png, centre and jacket outline)

5. Obvious clones and hair problems: the same short-haired blonde repeats across rows, and the bottom-right man's hair is a helmet-like shell; bright rim edges on the left arms of front-row figures look like a compositing halo (theatre-2-mid.png, middle row; theatre-3-mid.png, bottom right and left figures)

1. Hair alpha is dithered and stippled: a noisy dotted fringe around the yellow-shirt man's hair and a split seam across the top of the afro, very visible on a close shot (openmic-4-face.png, top right of head; openmic-6-held.png, centre-top afro and right head)

2. Bodies overlap and interpenetrate in the packed front row: shoulders and arms sit inside each other, and in the strip the green-top woman's hand merges into her neighbour's arm (openmic-1-wide.png, front row centre-left; openmic-5-strip.png, t=13.0 centre)

3. The wide is a crowd crammed into a box with a bare, flat back wall, an unlit glowing door card and an empty dark ceiling; the room feels like a set with no stage spill gradient (openmic-1-wide.png, upper half and left door)

4. Faces mostly read, but skin is plastic and eyes are glassy and fixed; several background faces stare blankly straight ahead (openmic-4-face.png, background right; openmic-6-held.png, back-left heads)

5. Posture stiffness: several people sit with arms straight down and hands clamped on their knees, the same rest pose repeated, and the cap man is hunched forward at an odd angle (openmic-1-wide.png, front row; openmic-6-held.png, left)
